YOUR REVIEW FOUND A HOLE THE SELF-REVIEW DID NOT, and it is now fixed. The Ceiling's spec asked Stage 2 for "does it place, where, how many vertices, and at which rungs". That cannot distinguish a working CHEMOSYNTHATE weight from a decorative one. xorn's niche is 0.65 MINERAL / 0.35 CHEMOSYNTHATE, so a settled kind on that shape could place entirely on its mineral half while the chemotrophic weight does nothing -- the campaign reproducing the exact defect it exists to close, and reporting it as success.

M4 is now frozen in the spec BEFORE the kind is authored:
  arm (a) FULL       the authored kind, unmodified
  arm (b) ABLATED    the same world with the CHEMOSYNTHATE supply zeroed
  arm (c) PER-SOURCE seven variants, each zeroing one EnergySource in turn

placed(b) == placed(a) is a RED that returns the authoring to the niche rather than being written up as a finding. Arm (c) is the provenance half you asked for, and it calls out DetritalImport separately: a kind that depends on it is eating the surface at depth, not living on chemical energy.
